request: Analyze GSE121868 and GSE123865 for the paper (ExRNA Atlas Analysis Reveals Distinct Extracellular RNA Cargo Types and Their Carriers Present Across Human Biofluids, PMC6616370): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Paper's exercise estimand: pre- (baseline) vs post-exercise (Bruce treadmill) plasma exRNA miRNA abundance, within deconvoluted cargo profiles and by DESeq2 on read counts (Baseline n=26 vs post-Exercise n=26). The exercise samples are in GSE121874 (S4.3.1.p1; KRT row 'Small RNA-seq during acute maximal exercise', GEO GSE121874). GSE121868 is the subarachnoid hemorrhage CSF/plasma atlas dataset used only as an input to cargo-type deconvolution.
planned_contrasts: post-Exercise vs Baseline miRNAs (S2.11.p3, S4.6.2.8.p1; paper: 53 DE miRNAs across 3 cargo types by deconvolution t-test; DESeq2 'Shah et al.' circle in Fig 7C) -- samples in GSE121874, not in GSE121868
final.paper_method: exceRpt read counts; deconvolution (Stage 2) per group + t-test per cargo profile with FDR; DESeq2 Baseline vs post-Exercise
final.role_of_this_accession: GSE121868: aSAH patients only (no controls), 523 plasma/CSF samples from 30 donors; used for cargo-type discovery (S4.3.1.p1), no exercise factor
final.paper_results: 53 DE miRNAs (17 overlap Shah et al. DESeq2: CT3B 1, CT4 16); CT4 proportion change p=0.001 (S2.11.p2-p3, FIG7)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The only exercise analysis in the paper (S2.11, S4.6.2.8, FIG7) uses the Exercise challenge study EXR-SADAS1EXER1-AN = GEO GSE121874 (S4.3.1.p1). GSE121868 is listed in S4.3.1.p1 and the KRT as 'Profiles of Extracellular RNA in Cerebrospinal Fluid and Plasma from Subarachnoid Hemorrhage Patients' and is used only to define cargo types.

ownership.reasoning: Files belong to the paper's GSE121868 (n=523 matches S4.3.1.p1). They do not contain the paper's exercise samples, which are deposited under GSE121874.

alignment.stop_reason: No exercise contrast can be identified: GSE121868 holds only subarachnoid hemorrhage patients' plasma and CSF (Series_overall_design: 523 samples from 30 donors, all aSAH, no controls); metadata has no exercise field. In addition, matrix columns (sample_B1010_ATGAGC_fastq style) match no metadata field (inspect alignment_keys empty; titles look like 44D04BLO; no description column; the SOFT file has no B1010 token), so samples cannot be aligned except by position. Resolving the alignment would not create an exercise arm, so the case is refused rather than sent to manual review.
alignment.reasoning: Inspect reported no alignment key; the paper's exercise samples are in GSE121874, not this series.
